29 duplicate feature vector clusters span more than one 'sample_id', covering 2902 rows (70.4% of the corpus, above 5.0%). Grouping by 'sample_id' therefore does not stop feature identical rows appearing in both train and test, so the held out score is optimistic.

single feature 'n_lines' reaches macro F1 0.910 on its own (above 0.70) against a chance level of 0.091. One scalar is carrying the attribution result, so the corpus has an artifact dependent shortcut rather than a transformation signature.

chance corrected headroom R is 0.090 (below 0.50). The best single feature 'n_lines' recovers 91.0% of the gap between chance and the full feature set, so the remaining features add little and the reported result is close to a one feature rule dressed up as a learned model.
the best 2 features together reach macro F1 0.964 (above 0.70) with a depth 8 tree. A 2 feature rule settles the label, so the corpus is separable without the representation the paper is arguing for.
